description: This Java class 'BulkWriteResultAckFlow' is part of a persistence layer in a larger application. It manages acknowledgments and error reporting based on MongoDB bulk write operation results, integrated into an Akka Streams flow. The class handles processing of batch write results, error detection, logging, and sending acknowledgments or failure responses to other system components via actors.

classes.name: BulkWriteResultAckFlow
classes.description: A final class encapsulating the logic for processing MongoDB bulk write results, generating acknowledgments, logging errors, and communicating status updates through Akka actors within a reactive stream.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new BulkWriteResultAckFlow with a specified ActorRef as the updater shard.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates an Akka Stream Flow that processes WriteResultAndErrors objects, checking each bulk write result and generating corresponding acknowledgment or error logs.

methods.name: checkBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Processes a WriteResultAndErrors instance to determine acknowledgement status, detect errors or inconsistencies, perform logging, and return a list of log or error messages.

methods.name: acknowledgeFailures
methods.description: Increments error counters and sends failure responses for a list of Metadata objects to the updater shard actor.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends acknowledgement messages for a list of Metadata objects using a provided response creator function, packaging responses into ShardedMessageEnvelope and sending via Akka actor.

methods.name: createFailureResponse
methods.description: Creates an UpdateThingResponse indicating failure for given Metadata.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs an UpdateThingResponse with detailed metadata and success status.

methods.name: wasNotAcknowledged
methods.description: Checks if the bulk write result was not acknowledged.

methods.name: checkForConsistencyError
methods.description: Verifies if the bulk write result is consistent with the write models, returning an error string if inconsistencies are detected.

methods.name: areAllIndexesWithinBounds
methods.description: Ensures all error indexes from bulk write errors are within the expected range.

methods.name: getAllThings
methods.description: Collects all Metadata objects from the write models for error reporting.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Generates a detailed log message based on the bulk write outcome, including success, partial success, or errors, and stack trace if an unexpected error occurred.
